why: Both concern cross-room cooperation with France, and the material mixes truce-making with actual help/defence, making primary choice hard.

why.T3-149: The item is framed as making peace with France: ceasefire requests and a sought alliance/ceasefire put it on truce-making rather than mere help or border settlement.
why.T3-011: Several concepts show German members helping/defending French or EU work (repairing the French flag, defending French blue, fixing the EU flag), which the truce gate does not carry.
why.T3-076: Several concepts tell Germany's own attackers to stop against France/EU, which is reining in the room's attackers, not making a truce or sending help.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-149's truce gate covers the ceasefire and alliance talk but not the actual pixel help and protection given to French/EU works.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1331445 (helping French neighbours repair), C0400025 (defending French blue), and C0875588 (fixing the European flag) satisfy T3-011's gate of sending help to another room's work.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-011 if forced to one; the record would lose the direct help/repair actions, though the peace-making core would remain.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-149 and T3-011 do not carry the calls telling Germany's own attackers to stop attacking France/EU.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0858362 (telling Germans to stop attacking the French flag), C0976006 (challenging Germany for attacking its EU teammate), and C0468095 (telling Germany to stop making the reich happen) satisfy T3-076's gate of reining in the room's attackers.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-076 if forced to one; the record would lose the explicit repudiation of the room's own attacks, but the peace/help pairing would remain.

why.T3-024: The concepts ask Germany to spare/incorporate existing Fire Emblem, Pokémon, Megumin, and other art rather than devour it, which is the restraint toward others' work gate; the reciprocal EXO/help requests are incidental to that sparing.

why.T3-037: The concepts praise the canvas event itself as beautiful/epic and what a simple pixel game became, a positive judgement of the canvas's worth rather than a room's finished mark or a reflection on cooperation.

why.T3-042: Both concepts put repairing gaps/vandalism before taking new territory, which is choosing upkeep over expansion.

why.T3-005: The item's core is defending the German flag from the void/black plague: calls for constant attention, buffers, warnings about the void's route, and refusing the tendril put it on defence against attackers.
why.T3-011: Concepts also redirect help to the EU and Swiss flags, which is sending pixels to another room's defence rather than only defending the room's own work.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-005 covers the defence of the German flag against the void/black plague, but not the material where members head to or ask for help for the EU and Swiss flags.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1322928 (telling Germany to help against the black plague on the EU), C1338136 (heading over to help), and C1192404 (asking for help for the Swiss) satisfy T3-011's gate of sending help to another room's work.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-011 if forced to one; the placement would still cover the German flag defence but would lose the help sent to other flags.

why.T3-024: The single concept contrasts r/ainbowroad's respect and protection of other art with expansion, fitting restraint toward others' work.

why.T3-192: The member admits modifying video-game sprites to look surprised for amusement, which is griefing the work for fun rather than a tactical attack or ordinary in-joke.

why.T3-082: The post makes the Comedian badge visible and the reply recognizes it after uncertainty; it is discovering the room's own subject already drawn, not announcing a room-made mark.

why.T3-009: The WE DID IT posts mark the room's work as achieved, which is celebrating the finished work.
why.T3-043: One concept thanks everyone who participated, which credits the people who made the work.
why.T3-117: One concept states that r/place has come to an end, which registers the end of the canvas event.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009's celebration gate marks success but does not carry the explicit thanks/credit to everyone who participated.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1109509 thanks everyone that participated, satisfying T3-043's gate of crediting the people who made the work.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-043 if forced to one; the placement would still mark the achieved work but would lose the gratitude/credit.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 and T3-043 do not carry the registration that the r/place event itself has ended.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0195068 announces that r/place has come to an end, satisfying T3-117's gate of marking the canvas's end.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-117 if forced to one; the placement would still celebrate and credit the work but would lose the explicit end-of-event closure.

why.T3-050: The 7-1 jokes are football taunts aimed at Brazil/Brazilian flag; proposals to place or remove them are rival-directed mocking, not a room in-joke or an attack to destroy the flag.

why.T3-031: The concept is a self-deprecating joke about prior calls to defend Germany, a running room joke in canvas talk rather than a taunt at a rival.

why.T3-073: The concepts report what happened to familiar works on the canvas, especially the live report that the Void is consuming the Flames logo, which is the reporting-how-the-work-fared gate rather than a border or defence call.
